decisions.reason: The net price display plugin sits close to the core shop offer and costs little to maintain, so the option stays open even though its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 points to modest value.

E is the last of several redundant price comparison trackers, its siblings C and D were already pruned, and four years without visible traction suggest its value will not be realized, so the resources should go to the core business and new development.
The net price reporting plugin complements A and the firm's analytics services at low maintenance cost, so keeping it remains a cheap option despite its limited visibility.
